{{- $site := . -}}
{{- $multilingual := gt (len hugo.Sites) 1 -}}
{{- $description := partial "./text.txt" ($site.Params.description | default "") -}}
# {{ partial "./text.txt" $site.Title }} - {{ partial "./text.txt" ($site.Language.Label | default $site.Language.Lang) }}
{{ with $description }}
> {{ . }}
{{ end }}
Canonical site: {{ $site.BaseURL }}
Sitemap: {{ if $multilingual }}{{ absURL (printf "%s/sitemap.xml" $site.Language.Lang) }}{{ else }}{{ absURL "sitemap.xml" }}{{ end }}
{{ if $multilingual }}
## Languages
{{ range sort hugo.Sites "Language.Weight" -}}
{{- $languageSite := . -}}
{{- if ne .Language.Lang $site.Language.Lang -}}
{{- with .Home.OutputFormats.Get "LLMS" }}
- [{{ partial "./text.txt" ($languageSite.Language.Label | default $languageSite.Language.Lang) }}](<{{ .Permalink }}>)
{{ end -}}
{{ end -}}
{{ end -}}
{{ end -}}
{{- $groups := newScratch -}}
{{- range (partial "system-metadata/sitemap/pages.html" $site) -}}
  {{- $root := .CurrentSection | default $site.Home -}}
  {{- $group := $groups.Get $root.Path | default (dict "root" $root "pages" slice) -}}
  {{- $groups.Set $root.Path (dict "root" $root "pages" ($group.pages | append .)) -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- range $groups.Values }}

{{- $labels := slice -}}
{{- range .root.Ancestors.Reverse -}}
  {{- if not .IsHome -}}{{- $labels = $labels | append .Title -}}{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
{{- $labels = $labels | append .root.Title -}}
{{ printf "\n\n" }}## {{ partial "./text.txt" (delimit $labels " / ") }}
{{ range .pages -}}
{{ $entryDescription := partial "./text.txt" (.Params.description | default "") -}}
- [{{ partial "./text.txt" .Title }}](<{{ .Permalink }}>){{ with $entryDescription }}: {{ . }}{{ end }}
{{ end -}}
{{ end -}}
